title: SUBSCRIBE_TRIP v1 (client -> server)
description: Follow one trip of the caller (FR-RT): the customer then receives the assigned driver's position as TRIP_DRIVER_LOCATION (BR-013). Allowed only for the trip's customer or assigned driver, until the trip has been over for the grace period. Answered with TRIP_SUBSCRIBED, or ERROR RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND for any trip the caller may not follow (unknown and foreign trips look the same). Subscriptions end with the connection: subscribe again after reconnecting.
